tests.action: Start unchanged M1.4 room with no recovery component or safety volumes.
tests.expected: Existing bootstrap remains supported; no safe-return guarantee claimed.

tests.action: Add one recovery component to possessed character, valid safety volumes and dry fallback.
tests.expected: Original bootstrap initializes recovery before native UI; no automatic campaign creation.

tests.action: Use unpossessed owner, duplicate recovery components or competing manual/bootstrap calls.
tests.expected: Preflight/initialization rejects them; partial binding requires relaunch.

tests.action: Place safety volumes without a recovery component.
tests.expected: Startup blocks rather than presenting inactive safety volumes as functioning protection.

tests.action: Tilt/zero-scale/negatively scale a volume or use malformed extents.
tests.expected: Startup/destination validation rejects invalid authored geometry.

tests.action: Set fall boundary below or too close to actual engine KillZ.
tests.expected: Startup blocks; no automatic change of host world settings.

tests.action: Start New and verify first generation before touching a safety zone.
tests.expected: Normal pending-versus-verified save behavior retained.

tests.action: Stand on actual dry floor in a single checkpoint region.
tests.expected: A checkpoint records after continuous dwell, not immediately on an overlap event.

tests.action: Remain in one checkpoint for many frames and inspect save-generation changes.
tests.expected: Only one checkpoint-triggered save request per visit; unrelated autosaves are distinguished.

tests.action: Leave a checkpoint and return; change session or open/close a menu mid-dwell.
tests.expected: Dwell resets appropriately; a later deliberate visit can record again.

tests.action: Overlap two checkpoint regions.
tests.expected: No checkpoint is chosen by actor iteration order.

tests.action: Jump through a checkpoint region or stand on an unsafe/absent floor.
tests.expected: Airborne/unsafe samples do not record a checkpoint.

tests.action: Enter the deep-water proxy with a required item carried.
tests.expected: Fade/return/stability check completes; carried item and objective facts remain unchanged.

tests.action: Enter the route-boundary proxy.
tests.expected: Returns without damage or inventory mutation.

tests.action: Move below the configured recovery plane in a disposable test session.
tests.expected: Return occurs before engine destruction at tested fall speeds/frame times; no respawned replacement pawn.

tests.action: Store a required part, return from a hazard, then inspect backpack/storage.
tests.expected: Instance IDs, quantities, placement, receipt ledger and mission readiness remain coherent.

tests.action: Repair, acknowledge transcript, then trigger a return.
tests.expected: Repair is not repeated; parts are not consumed again; transcript and lead retained.

tests.action: Queue an autosave immediately before recovery starts; try manual save/load/new during the return.
tests.expected: No capture/mutation/IO begins mid-return; pending request survives and writes after safe completion.

tests.action: Block the last checkpoint after leaving it, keeping initial fallback safe.
tests.expected: At most one primary and one distinct fallback attempt; explicit fallback notice.

tests.action: Block both destinations using disposable backed-up saves.
tests.expected: No origin/random warp; fades clear; sticky recovery screen; further writes/interaction blocked.

tests.action: Arrange collision so teleport fitting adjusts the requested position.
tests.expected: Actual resulting transform is revalidated for return and campaign load; unsafe result is not accepted.

tests.action: Remove or move support after placement, or introduce a hazard during settling.
tests.expected: No repeated teleport loop; failure exits the fade and requires relaunch.

tests.action: Hold or press Jump/Interact during fade and settling; repeat on keyboard and gamepad.
tests.expected: Lower-priority gameplay input is blocked; no unexpected jump/interaction on return; fresh release required for Boolean actions.

tests.action: Press Pause/Inventory/Journal during active return and immediately afterward.
tests.expected: No modal opens midway through relocation; menus remain usable afterward; no double action.

tests.action: Retain an independently owned controller move/look lock while returning.
tests.expected: Only recovery-owned lock counts/input component are released; other owners remain intact.

tests.action: Run with fade disabled and with an existing cinematic fade before the return.
tests.expected: Recovery works without seizing an existing fade; no audio fading imposed.

tests.action: Pause externally during return, then resume in the same session.
tests.expected: Game-time phase stops/resumes without a mixed snapshot; host pause/fade ownership remains separate.

tests.action: Test variable FPS, a large hitch and high fall velocities.
tests.expected: Document real behavior; a single hitch cannot count as stable grounding; no claim from helper tests.

tests.action: Destroy recovery component or pawn during an active campaign; invalidate cached safety volume.
tests.expected: Session fails closed as specified, owned resources tear down, no unsafe save or silent pawn rebinding.

tests.action: Return successfully, wait for verified generation, exit/relaunch/Continue.
tests.expected: Whole campaign restores with safe checkpoint and unchanged inventory/mission/world/journal.

tests.action: Force a supported platform write-failure scenario after a successful return using disposable saves.
tests.expected: Return success is not labelled saved; write failure remains visible and prior generation recoverable.

tests.action: Cook/package actual test map and launch outside editor with real AGIS/Hyper.
tests.expected: Complete original campaign and new return loop; record actual engine, toolchain, vendor versions and evidence.
